templates.why_chosen: High-confidence matrix exemplar of six numbered self-contained panels read column by column, each a mini-diagram of one compiler stage, tied together by one shared node-colour legend and one running worked example.
templates.what_to_learn: When a pipeline has too many stages for one row, fold it into a numbered grid read column by column, and keep one running worked example visible in every cell; a legend placed only at the bottom is far from the panels that need it first, so place it near the top instead.

templates.why_chosen: Six panels reuse one green/orange/red op-node vocabulary, Element-wise, Compute-intensive, Reduction, defined once in a legend at the bottom, to show the same neural-network graph being formulated, rescheduled, tuned and finally fused into a Monolithic Kernel.
templates.what_to_learn: Carry one small set of node-colour meanings across all six panels, and run a single shared example, SIS1, SIS2, CI Op, through every stage so a reader tracks one case end to end.
